cards.issue_title: Explore banks has no top-three offer optimizations
summary_4_lines: On Explore banks they said a feature still has to be built: top three optimizations so a user can reach a better offer over the next few months to a year.
The page they sat on only shows loan inputs and a Canara Bank row. There are no tips, no next-best-offer path, and no intelligence block.
They also said that feature must not be labeled AI, must be accurate (salary, gap between offers), and should look like product advice the way Google Flights shows low prices.
cards.pinpoint: On Explore banks, while idle on the loan form and Canara Bank row, they said this feature still needs to be built: take the list of offers and suggest the top three optimizations so the user can reach the best offer in the next few months to one year — and that advice must not be shown as AI.
cards.on_screen_object: Explore banks main view (loan inputs + bank options table); missing top-three optimizations / tips block
quotes_sample: You suggest top three optimizations that the user can reach the best offer in the next few months to one year.
should we show them that this is all AI driven? No, no. Zero.
Top 3 tips. But they must be accurate.
related_discussion_one_liners: Complexity: “not very complex” unless “age” is added; they already have a list of offers and do not actually use an LLM.

Engineering vs customer: Postgres/backend analogy — AI is “just another engineering tool”; Netflix (“We think you will like this”) and Google Flights (low prices without saying AI) as how to show intelligence.
Trust of basis: if AI and “the actual CA” disagree, people trust the CA; “You are an AI driven company in engineering… I have lost my trust. You said you are a CA driven company.”
Competitor Birbal: funding goes to AI companies and tele-calling is now AI; they should not copy “we are AI” for funding — “It is not our competition.”

Helpfulness risk (“how can you be so helpful?” / “you are giving so much money”) they said is okay; company-trust talk (no bank income, “two kids working in the basement,” strong testimonials, Reddit launch, talk to every customer, surveys + gift cards) continues into wb-rec-260815-2231.
